verdict.rationale: DPMA runs online register, search and e-filing services, so registrable outbound event callbacks (for example on register or application status changes) are a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence covers only DEPATISnet, DPMAregister, the DPMAdirekt filing routes and paper or fax filing, with no mention of webhooks, event subscriptions or any outbound HTTP callback mechanism. The robots.txt probe shows only crawl restrictions on the register host and says nothing about webhooks.
